- generic: It depends on where the flower is. The flower moves up the stem as it each spike ages. As long as you don't cut the flower of it will regrow so just cut right at the bend, then, if leaves come out of the center, your good. If a solid piece pushes out of the center, the flower was cut and the whole leaf spike should be removed. If fruit is still connected, leave any leaf spike that's laying down as the fruit will still finish.
